as_told.title: UFO trapped in Belt canyon escapes between helicopters

plain: This story takes place in 1967 near Belt, a small town in Montana not far from an Air Force base. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, relays an account from a man named Bob Jameson that a UFO went down into a canyon near the town and was trapped there. A former Air Force officer, Robert Salas, tells it too, also citing Jameson, and adds that once daylight came the military sent helicopters, and the UFO shot right out between them and escaped. If true, it would mean the military tried and failed to capture a craft near its own bases.
